lang.name: English
hero.title: Connect Your Jagex Account
hero.desc: Sign in with Jagex to load your RuneScape characters, manage accounts, and launch with one click.
chars.none: No characters found for this account.
wifi.tooltip: Sends a small "u up?" to your wifi router and reduces game lag due to wifi
wifi.desc_off: Sends a UDP keepalive to the default gateway every 10ms to prevent 802.11 sleep jitter
settings.title: Launcher Configuration
settings.runelite_jar_ph: Leave empty to use automatically detected RuneLite
settings.hdos_jar_ph: Leave empty to use automatically detected HDOS
settings.close_after_desc: Automatically terminates the rustyBolt process once the client starts
settings.isolate_home_desc: Keep rustyBolt RuneLite settings in a dedicated folder separate from ~/.runelite
setup.title: One-time login setup
setup.desc: Logging in through your browser lets you use your password manager. To receive the last step of the Jagex login, rustyBolt needs one privileged change:
setup.password_note: Your system will ask for your password once. Nothing runs with elevated rights afterwards.
login.title: Connect Jagex Account
login.step1: Open the official Jagex authorization portal in your browser:
login.step2: After logging in, your browser redirects to a confirmation page. Copy the address bar URL and paste it here:
login.in_browser: Sign in to Jagex in your browser
login.in_window: Sign in to Jagex in the window that opened
keychain.title: Keychain unavailable
keychain.desc: Logins cannot be saved until the system keychain works. On Linux, a Secret Service such as GNOME Keyring or KDE Wallet must be running and unlocked.
keychain.toast: The system keychain is unavailable; a login could not be saved.
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.desc: Saves a zip with the launcher report and the client logs for a bug report. Account, character and user names, ids, addresses and emails are removed first.
profile.title: Global profile overrides
profile.desc: Key and value pairs written into every RuneLite profile before each launch, so every profile on this machine gets the same values. Any RuneLite setting works: the key is the plugin name, a dot and the setting name, as in RuneLite's own profile files. A backup of each changed file sits next to it with a .bak suffix.
profile.enable_desc: Off leaves every profile file alone.
profile.strip: Remove settings that start with (one per line)
